title: F422 Private Bus Router Scope Command Boundaries on MH200

environment.bus_topology: Main SCS bus with F422 interface router on domain 02

device_under_test.description: SCS bus interface router (configured as private interface 02)

summary: Empirical evidence that general and area scope automation commands (*2*1*1#4#02##) do NOT cross the F422 bus interface router despite syntactically valid OpenWebNet grammar. Only point commands (*2*1*11#4#02##) cross to the private bus. Conversely, area status requests (*#2*1#4#02##) are forwarded and answered with per-object frames.
